item.text:
Implemented the Rust Cargo project in `/output` with the required entry file [test15.rs](/output/test15.rs), plus reusable library modules [args.rs](/output/src/args.rs), [hopscotch_map.rs](/output/src/hopscotch_map.rs), [app.rs](/output/src/app.rs), and [lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs). It uses only `std`, keeps the C++ default/flag behavior, and matches `std::stoi`-style parsing closely enough to reproduce the reference program’s normal output and its abort behavior for missing/invalid `--a` values.

Verification passed with `cargo test`, `cargo build --release`, and `rustc /output/test15.rs -o /output/test15`. The built executables are `/output/test15` and `/output/target/release/test15`. I also compared them against `/workspace/dataset/test15_executable` on the provided cases and additional edge cases; the results matched.
